gloss: to be complete, to be uniform

definitions.gloss: to be complete, to be gathered
definitions.explanation: For all members or items to be present.
For things to be the same or aligned.

examples.japanese: {サイズ|さいず}が{揃|そろ}っている。

notes:
{揃|そろ}う means to be complete or uniform.

TRANSITIVITY:
- {揃|そろ}う (intransitive): to be complete
- {揃|そろ}える (transitive): to arrange

USAGE:
- People gathering
- Items being complete
- Things being uniform
